cells.title: Oral Surgery in McLean & Alexandria, VA | Dr. Nahlah

props.text: Comprehensive care does not stop at
Extractions, bone grafting and implant placement, done in this building by the specialist who will also restore the tooth afterwards.
The person who removes it also replaces it.
Elsewhere the extraction goes to a surgeon and the replacement to somebody else. Between them sits a handover, and the handover is where the plan gets lost.
Three procedures, in the comfort of the office.
Each one done here, kept minimally invasive by the technology used to plan it.
The tooth is eased out without disturbing healthy bone or gum, which matters enormously if anything is going back in the space later. Wisdom teeth are the more complex form.
Bone loss after a missing tooth is ongoing, not one-off, and has to be treated before an implant has anything to hold on to. Placed, sutured, and left a few months to integrate.
The post is placed into the jawbone to anchor a new tooth or a full set. CT-guided placement makes it precise, and qualifying patients leave with a temporary the same day.
Being nervous about this is normal.
The practice does not pretend otherwise. What it does is remove the reasons the fear is usually justified.
Techniques kept as minimally invasive as the case allows
Planned on a 3D scan first, so less is done by feel
Nitrous oxide or oral sedation, whichever suits you
A private suite, with the door closed
Oral sedation has to be planned ahead. It is worth asking for at the consultation, not on the day.
Anatomy, the four options, and how a case runs.
Nitrous oxide and oral sedation, and how each one feels.
Six surgical suites, the CBCT scanner and the in-house lab.
Get the whole sequence explained before any of it starts, including what happens afterwards.
Implant dentistry and prosthodontics for Northern Virginia, rebuilding smiles that other practices call too complex.
